name: STAR Frames — IAU 1976 precession between J2000 and the mean equator of date
summary: IAU 1976 precession matrix and vector rotations between J2000 and the mean equator and equinox of date over 1800-2200; equal to ERFA pmat76 to 1.2e-16 and within 0.21 arcsec of PyEphem's own precession.
reference: SOFA validation of pmat76 at (2400000.5, 50123.9999): first row 0.9999995504328350733, 0.8696632209480960785e-3, 0.3779153474959888345e-3; Lieske (1979) precession angles adopted by the IAU in 1976
reference_observed: the three published elements and element [2][2] reproduced within 1e-15

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: two-part Julian Dates (TT) in; dimensionless matrix, arcseconds for the angles; direction of the rotation stated (r_mod = P r_j2000)
review.G-06: no external data; the nine coefficients are in the module and pinned by a test
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for invalid input and for dates outside 1800-2200; no iteration, no extrapolation
